title: Agentic AI OS: trace-replay prototype of a policy-governed LLM control plane
description: Reference implementation, configuration, LLM response cache, decision audit logs and run-level results for the paper 'Agentic AI Operating Systems for Enterprise Autonomy: A Policy-Governed LLM Control Plane for Workload Scheduling and Failure Recovery'. Trace replay of the Google 2019 Cluster Sample comparing FIFO, a priority heuristic, the policy-governed control plane without an LLM, and the same control plane with a local Llama 3 8B model (Ollama).
